Federal workers who agreed to resign their posts by February 12, 2025 , were allowed to keep getting paid through the end of September, when the federal fiscal year ended. About 140,000 workers took the offer. The OPM instructed federal agencies to place those workers on administrative leave and reassign their responsibilities.
